summary: Sinkhole near taxiway Alpha at EGOV: aircraft must not taxi or park over the marked 10-metre square area.
text:
SINK HOLE ON SOURTHERN EDGE OF AIRCRAFT SERVICING PLATFORM 3
IN VCY OF TWY ALPHA PSN 531459N 0043200W WI 10M SQUARED
